name: io.github.smarter-poker/mcp-server
display_name: Smarter.Poker Live Poker, GTO Strategy & Equity MCP Server
description: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Smarter.Poker providing 15 zero-auth tools for North American live poker room discovery (324+ venues), tournament series schedules, exact Holdem/PLO equity calculation, 100BB 6-Max GTO preflop charts, Malmuth-Harville ICM payouts, starting hand lookup, first-party poker research benchmarks, competitor comparisons, and 107+ interactive training simulators.
